purpose: Callgrind totals of measurement/step.c (organizer image and flags) on two input sets (seeds 1 and 2) at 1 and 2 batch steps of 65536 walks, plain = Ir(2)-Ir(1); previous_kernel: before the last change, at 1 and 2 on both sets; earlier_kernel: before the two kernel changes, at 1, 2, 4, 8, 63 and 64, anchor = Ir(64)-Ir(63). Inputs: the first 132096 generator lines (2^16 adders, 2^16 walks, 1024 spares).
kernel: step.c with p256_fused.h: batch_step's subtractions, products and square in fused kernels that keep values in registers; the products of k_submul and k_mul2 end in a carry-only finish below 2^256, and the last prefix product (acc) is k_subb_bl then k_subm, canonical; rare paths out of line, unchanged

per_round_fall.rule: 917,495 then 262,119 (proof.md: 18 per walk less 34 in all), the measured plain falls on both sets; the walk state equals the earlier kernel's after every round, so each round takes the same branches

exactness: seed 1, organizer flags: dump and event line identical to the previous kernel's at 8 batch steps (walk_ref.py check: 0 mismatches), at 64 with DP_BITS=7, FILTER_MASK=0x3f, CAP_PERIODS=3, at 32 with DP_BITS=55, and at B=1024, ADDER_BITS 4 (600 steps: 813 long cycles, 1609 abandoned)
compiled_identity: objdump -d, organizer flags, addresses normalised: every function but batch_step is identical to the previous and earlier kernels' at ADDER_BITS 16 and 24, so measurement/forced/summary.json applies; batch_step differs only inside the fused kernels' asm, in the last prefix product's two calls, in register choice and in no-ops after dp_restart. At 24 it differs from 16 only in mask and shift immediates, branch offsets and no-ops, running 2 more per batch round (before its first loop), which accounting.py adds

common_path_bound.method: disassembly of the organizer-flag build; every conditional branch run once per walk
branches_per_walk: distinguished-point test, one compare of (key>>24)|(x.v[1] & mask) with 0: taken only at a distinguished point (dp_restart, a rare event)
previous-key filter match: rare_2cycle (a rare event)
anchor filter match: rare_anchor (a rare event)
trail cap, anchor rounds only: new_trail (an abandonment, a rare event)
